name: Deliberative Poll on Federalism Reform in Japan
content: Problems and Purpose Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection Methods and Tools Used This event used the Deliberative Polling method which involves various tools of engagement including surveys (before and after), information and question and answer periods with experts , small group deliberation (such as thematic dialogue tables or future workshops ) and plenary discussion.
